items.grounds: Adversarially re-derived both ways. The verse's own language noun is יְהוּדִ֑ית (oshb:Isa.36.13, tier: byte — re-collated), and the WEB witness reads “in the Jews’ language” (web:Isa.36.13); the word 'Hebrew' occurs in neither witness at this verse (checked against the staged WEB bytes). The shipped literature_type_guess applies 'public Hebrew proclamation' while the same row's boundary_rationale itself states that neither witness labels this proclamation 'Hebrew' — the row ships in its type field the exact label its own disclosure denies both witnesses. 'Hebrew' is not false of the verse's language (staged morph tally: all codes H-prefixed, no Aramaic zone — Phase-0 book fact), but as shipped it reads as a witness-carried label, which the row's own sentence proves it is not, and the Aramaic-only language-zone guard cannot see a 'Hebrew' label, so the self-contradiction shipped unflagged. Defect real, in a non-load-bearing guess field, no boundary resting on it: severity medium as filed.

Re-derived. The rear-seam warrant is an uncited content mention — 'before the officials' silence closes the scene in the following unit' — carrying no numeral, so the refs-mirror arm (which resolves only numeral-bearing verse mentions) could not see it; boundary_evidence_refs tops out at web:Isa.36.20 / oshb:Isa.36.16, with no 36:21 entry on either witness and no oshb:Isa.36.20 either. The decisive onset signal is real but absent from the row: MT 36:21 opens verse-initial וַֽיַּחֲרִ֔ישׁוּ (oshb:Isa.36.21, tier: byte — re-collated), the wayyiqtol subject switch to the officials, continuing וְלֹֽא עָנ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ דָּבָ֑ר (oshb:Isa.36.21, tier: byte). The neighbor row quotes web:Isa.36.21 on the WEB side only and carries no oshb:Isa.36.21 ref and no 36:21 splice, so the seam has no pointed ground on either side, exactly as filed. Bound materially right, warrant defective and unpointed: medium (defective warrant, not alone load-bearing).

Re-derived the whole census. Verse-initial wayehi (first skeleton token of the verse) stands at exactly 7 verses book-wide — MT 7:1, 22:7, 36:1, 37:1, 37:38, 38:4, 48:19, re-derived by first-token scan of the staged MT extract — so the row's digit is right, and right at finals-normalized skeleton tier ONLY: at byte tier the seven carry six distinct forms, MT 7:1 and 36:1 alone coinciding, both opening וַיְהִ֡י (oshb:Isa.7.1, tier: byte; byte-identical first token at oshb:Isa.36.1), and the four zone sites the row lists are four DIFFERENT byte forms, each re-collated at tier byte at its own verse: וַיְהִ֡י (oshb:Isa.36.1), וַיְהִ֗י (oshb:Isa.37.1), וַיְהִי֩ (oshb:Isa.37.38), וַֽיְהִי֙ (oshb:Isa.38.4). At accent_stripped tier (meteg retained) the 38:4 form still differs from the other three. The row's digit sentence carries no tier label anywhere in it, so 'exact token match' stands as a byte-exactness claim the bytes refute; the recurrence is true only at the skeleton tier the proposal names. Tier-disclosure defect exactly as filed; the 37:1 seam itself is untouched. Confirm medium.

Re-derived. MT 7:1 opens וַיְהִ֡י (oshb:Isa.7.1, tier: byte — the same byte form that opens oshb:Isa.36.1) and pairs it with BOTH conditions: the temporal frame בִּימֵ֣י אָ֠חָז (oshb:Isa.7.1, tier: byte) and the explicit new subject עָלָ֣ה רְצִ֣ין (oshb:Isa.7.1, tier: byte) — the same campaign-onset shape, and even the same verb, as עָלָ֞ה סַנְחֵרִ֤יב (oshb:Isa.36.1, tier: byte). Across the rest of the seven-verse census: MT 37:38 pairs a temporal participial frame with only the continuing pronoun subject ה֨וּא (oshb:Isa.37.38, tier: byte); MT 38:4 has the explicit subject דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה (oshb:Isa.38.4, tier: byte) but no temporal frame; MT 22:7 and 48:19 carry neither pairing — so the both-conditions set is MT 7:1, 36:1, 37:1 book-wide. The shipped universal 'only oshb:Isa.36.1 and this verse pair it with both...' sits adjacent to its only digit, the book-wide '(sweep: 7 verses)', which is the scope the universal takes as shipped, and at that scope the bytes refute it; it is true only under an unstated restriction to the four zone sites. Scope-defective universal, not load-bearing for the 37:1 seam: confirm medium.

Re-derived from the shipped corpus order: this row spans Isa.37.14-Isa.37.20 and the immediately following unit spans Isa.37.21-Isa.37.35, so the prayer-verb reactivation אֲשֶׁר֙ הִתְפַּלַּ֣לְתָּ אֵלַ֔י (oshb:Isa.37.21, tier: byte — re-collated) sits ONE unit later, inside the divine frame that opens the very next unit; the device_notes locator 'two units later' is false. The same field's opening sentence has already placed the same oracle in 'the following unit', an internal contradiction between two statements about the same material inside one field, and the false phrase is a positional row-count locator where campaign register keeps cross-row references verse-anchored. The root-tier disclosure itself is sound and no bound moves. Confirm medium.

Re-derived mechanically on the shipped field bytes. The curly-quoted English run closing the rationale re-verifies verbatim against the staged WEB bytes of web:Isa.37.35 (a ref that also stands in boundary_evidence_refs), but in the field it is introduced by 'closes the unit at oshb:Isa.37.35, ' and post-cited '(oshb:Isa.37.35)' — WEB text attributed to the MT witness at both ends, with no web:Isa.37.35 anywhere in the field. Measured on the field: its web: refs are web:Isa.37.21 (three occurrences) and web:Isa.37.22 (two); none falls within 200 characters of either edge of the curly run, the nearest (a web:Isa.37.21) sitting 278 characters from the quote edge — and the staged verbatim gate binds a curly run only to web: refs within 200 characters of an edge and silently skips it otherwise (verified in the checker source), so the run escaped the mandated verbatim check exactly as filed. (The finding's batch-wide curly-run tally was not re-derivable from this slice and carries no weight in the verdict.) The adjacent Hebrew splice וְגַנּוֹתִ֛י עַל הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את (oshb:Isa.37.35, tier: byte — re-collated) is correctly attributed, and the English content is verbatim-true, so the defect is witness attribution and gate evasion, not content, and not load-bearing: confirm medium.

Re-derived. The staged WEB bytes open the verse with the run itself — “Yahweh will save me.” (web:Isa.38.20) is verse-initial — so the shipped locator 'at the close of the out-of-span web:Isa.38.20' is false of the verse it names (true of the psalm, whose final verse this is; false of the verse, whose head the run occupies). The rival side of the row's own person-contrast is carried by that English in STRAIGHT quotes, invisible to the curly-scanning verbatim gate, in a sentence with no oshb: ref, no splice and no tier label; no Hebrew from MT 38:20 is spliced anywhere in the rationale although oshb:Isa.38.20 stands in the refs. The first person is letter-visible in the pointed bytes: verse-initial יְהוָ֖ה לְהוֹשִׁיעֵ֑נִי (oshb:Isa.38.20, tier: byte — re-collated; the 1cs object suffix stands in the letters) and חַיֵּ֖ינוּ (oshb:Isa.38.20, tier: byte; the 1cp suffix); the near side of the same contrast is byte-grounded as shipped, וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ (oshb:Isa.38.21, tier: byte — re-collated). Engagement-class defect (translation-carried rival warrant) plus a false in-verse locator; the seam itself is unaffected. Confirm medium.

Re-collated and re-swept in full. Both splices are byte-true at their own verses: כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּבֵיתִי֙ (oshb:Isa.39.4, tier: byte) and כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּבֵיתֶ֗ךָ (oshb:Isa.39.6, tier: byte). Cross-collation returns tier none in BOTH directions (the 39:4 run against oshb:Isa.39.6; the 39:6 run against oshb:Isa.39.4) — the pronominal suffixes differ, כל אשר בביתי vs כל אשר בביתך at skeleton, so the pair is not a recurrence of the quoted runs at skeleton tier or any other. Re-sweeps at finals-normalized skeleton tier: כל אשר בביתי = 1 verse (MT 39:4); כל אשר בביתך = 1 verse (MT 39:6); the truncated shared run כל אשר בבית = 2 verses (MT 39:4 and MT 39:6) — the shipped 'sweep: 2 verses, finals-normalized skeleton tier' digit is attached to the two full runs but belongs to that unnamed truncation, a count-object mismatch exactly as filed, in contrast with the same episode's honest pairs where the identical convention IS true of the quoted runs: וזה לך האות = 2 verses (MT 37:30 and 38:7, skeleton tier) and וגנותי על העיר הזאת = 2 verses (MT 37:35 and 38:6, skeleton tier). The rear seam is unaffected: שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת (oshb:Isa.39.5, tier: byte — re-collated) re-sweeps unique at byte and skeleton alike (sweep: 1 verse book-wide). Confirm medium.
